category_title: Students with situational noncompliance in low-engagement settings
minimal_context: The student is supposed to be participating in a whole-class lesson on synonyms but is distracted by a computer in the loud classroom.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Alright everyone, please sit down so we can start our whole-class lesson on synonyms.

STUDENT: (Ignores the instruction and walks away from the group)

TUTOR: Kanita, we are doing synonyms right now. Please come back.

STUDENT: (Sits down at the computer and opens up Math Corner instead of joining the lesson)

TUTOR: Kanita, do not do Math Corner on the computer right now.

STUDENT: I am going to do it anyway.

options.A: Ask the student what they think went wrong instead of telling them what happened.
options.B: Place the student with an effective ED teacher for long-term instruction and support.
options.C: Maintain a quiet and relaxing environment, talk gently and slowly, and avoid loud speech.
options.D: Provide a clear beginning and end for each task during the synonyms lesson.
